report.summary: Reviewed the supplied packet read-only: the finite phone/email presence grammar in lib/source-presence-evidence.ts, its V3 wiring in lib/delivery-assessment.ts, the source-presence tests, and the packet's skill. The affirmative path uses the explicit encoding==="catalog_slots" guard (delivery-assessment.ts:346), and explicit V2 and legacy replays (tests:37-47) cannot enter the override. The negative whole-domain safe path is present: a candidate is accepted in the presence branch only when businessEvidenceCheck(criterion.id).kind !== "mismatch" (delivery-assessment.ts:308-310). I found one real defect: the affirmative guard in the source-only presence check cannot tell a true absence from a source it could not read. A body that has no text (whitespace-only) with no dynamic or inert markers is reported as "absent", which turns supported into insufficient_evidence and withholds risks (tests:48-52). There is no automatic promotion, pass, acceptance or payment anywhere in the reviewed path.

findings.title: Empty or whitespace-only body is treated as true absence, so a completed affirmative phone/email check is wrongly marked unknown
findings.evidence:
In visit(), the ambiguity markers are only set for media/slot elements and elements having the hidden/inert/aria-hidden/display:none/visibility:hidden attributes (lines 46-47). Line 56 marks a file uncertain only when its readable text is non-empty (normalize(text) truthy) and mentions a phone/@ signal but has no owner. Line 60 marks it uncertain only when matches(field, bodyText) is true for the whole body text. A parsed HTML page whose body text is empty by construction, e.g. ,

Welcome to our shop.

). Neither response can count as an established omission when neither has an explicit absence declaration. That makes the affirmative check react to the absence of a keyword rather than to a complete owner. I did not run anything: this is a source reading of lines 46-47, 56, 60 and 71.
findings.reproduction: Unexecuted trace. Files {'index.html': 'Contact'}. criterion={id:'coverage-1', title:'Original requirement 1', source:'The page content must list the shop telephone number.'}. Read returns uncertain=false because no img/slot/hidden attr sets it, text is '' so line 56 is skipped, and bodyText '' fails matches. owners=[] so line 71 returns kind 'absent'. In the test run() pipeline a raw 'supported' item therefore becomes insufficient_evidence with source_ambiguity (tests/source-presence-evidence.test.ts:50-51). That is the same result a supported claim gets for a body with no phone text. A model that returned changes_suggested for such a body would also keep changes_suggested, because the negative branch (delivery-assessment.ts:310-316) needs present or unknown.
findings.suggestion: Do not treat a file as certain when it yields no readable body text or no owner that could serve as an absence baseline. In read(), set uncertain=true when insideBody text is empty but the body contains children that may carry non-text content, for example any flow-container/owner element or form/input/img, so line 71 returns unknown rather than absent. Keep the existing present path unchanged.

limitations: Review was static and read-only. No tests, typecheck, build, browser, provider call or runtime trace was executed, so every statement is a source reading.

The packet did not include tests/parserbudget, crossblock, sourceonlyvisibility, exact-copy-evidence.ts, business-checks/source-business-evidence.ts, assessment-publication-policy.ts, assessment-obligations.ts, or assessment-completion.ts. Conditions around parser budgets, cross-block citation coverage (delivery-assessment.ts:350-351), withheld-risk policy and the stage-20 obligations metadata could therefore only be checked through the code shown here.
Stage-20 obligation metadata is additive and outside the presence grammar; I made no general semantic or product-flow claims about it beyond confirming it does not touch status promotion.

The grammar's scope is the single finite English/Chinese presence directive. Broad natural-language requirements, actual rendered visibility, phone validity and email deliverability remain unproven, as the code's own comments say. The PHAROS source-clear report gap is narrowed to this finite family only.
No environment, credentials, hidden files or unrelated context were inspected.
